svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Leg: 316 mm of 25 x 2 mm steel tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cross hole 10.2 mm, 12 mm from the top end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Foot: 80 x 60 x 6 mm plate welded square on the bottom end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: in the clevis under the coupler housing's front on an

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M10 bolt with a nyloc nut, snug so it stays where it is put.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Down, it holds the housing's axis 356 mm above the ground,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: level with a bicycle's rear axle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Up, it folds back under the housing and is held by a rubber

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: strap. Fold it up before riding.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: down, the trailer stands level and does not rock.
